# Security Policy

Please see [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) for the full security policy, including:

- How to report a vulnerability (private disclosure via GitHub Security Advisories)
- Response timelines

## Quick Reporting Link

➡️ **[Report a Vulnerability (Private)](https://github.com/cofedish/cofe-nekobox/security/advisories/new)**
